question: The ‘Charak Samhita’ is a treatise on which of the following subjects?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Medicine**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

 
 
• **Charak Samhita** is one of the foundational texts of **Ayurveda**, the traditional Indian system of medicine. 
 
• This ancient treatise was compiled by **Acharya Charaka** around the 2nd century BCE. 
 
• The text focuses on **internal medicine** (Kaya Chikitsa) and provides a detailed understanding of physiology, diagnosis, and treatment of various diseases. 
 
• It emphasizes the importance of maintaining a balance between the three doshas: **Vata, Pitta, and Kapha**, for ensuring good health.
